The structure of Li2Mn4FeO8 is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 15-atom unit cell and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral FeO4 and LiO4 environments, while Mn is six-coordinate to oxygen and O centers have four geometric neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Fe and Li tetrahedra linked by corner- and edge-sharing, plus corner-sharing between Fe and Mn polyhedra and edge-sharing between Mn and Li polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 15 sites.
